msg: warning: Variable buf is used uninitialized!
reasoning: TRUE POSITIVE (CORRECTLY CONSTRAINED): eef2317b9f5.c (BusyBox). Uninitialized value on 'buf' at line 30 ('if (buf)'), when def(CONFIG_FEATURE_CLEAN_UP). 'char *buf' is declared at line 6 without initialization. When cmd==8 (set when '-n' option is parsed), the code executes 'goto all_done' at line 23, bypassing the malloc at line 26. At the all_done label under #ifdef CONFIG_FEATURE_CLEAN_UP, 'if (buf)' at line 30 reads the uninitialized pointer. This is the known vbdb bug (//WARNING annotation at line 30). CORRECTLY CONSTRAINED: def(CONFIG_FEATURE_CLEAN_UP) is necessary and sufficient to compile the cleanup block where the uninitialized buf is read.
